description: This source file defines a WPF UserControl named DocumentPreview, which provides functionality to preview and render MigraDoc documents within a Windows application. It includes methods to set, clear, and navigate through pages of a document, and handles rendering pages to a visual element.

classes.name: DocumentPreview
classes.description: A WPF UserControl for viewing and navigating through rendered MigraDoc documents within a Windows application.

classes.name: DrawingVisualPresenter
classes.description: A helper class to encapsulate rendering of a DrawingVisual for display within the DocumentPreview control.

methods.name: SetDdl
methods.description: Sets the MigraDoc document from a DDL string or file, prepares rendering, and initializes the preview pages.

methods.name: GetSizeOfPage
methods.description: Retrieves the size (width and height) of a specified page within the document for rendering purposes.

methods.name: SetDocument
methods.description: Sets a new MigraDoc Document object for preview and prepares rendering.

methods.name: ClearDocument
methods.description: Clears the current document from the preview control.

methods.name: FirstPage
methods.description: Navigate the preview to the first page.

methods.name: NextPage
methods.description: Navigate to the next page of the document.

methods.name: PrevPage
methods.description: Navigate to the previous page of the document.

methods.name: LastPage
methods.description: Navigate the preview to the last page.
